description: Risk check for a token before buying or accepting it, on Solana (SPL and Token-2022) and on Base, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum or Polygon. Returns a verdict (low, medium, high, critical, or incomplete if the security feed is down), a one-sentence summary ready to show a user, and concrete flags. EVM: honeypot simulation, buy/sell tax, mintable, owner can change balances, hidden owner, blacklist, pausable transfers, proxy, unverified source, holder concentration, LP lock. Solana: freeze authority (the Solana honeypot pattern), mint authority, permanent delegate, transfer hook, transfer fee, non-transferable, frozen default state, malicious authorities, holder concentration. Both: DEX liquidity, pair age, 24h volume and price. Sources: GoPlus Security, DexScreener, on-chain RPC. Params: token (EVM contract address or Solana mint, required), chain (base default, solana, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon; a base58 mint is detected as Solana automatically). Price: $0.01 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"token":"0x4ed4E862860beD51a9570b96d89aF5E1B0Efefed","chain":"base"}.
